scope: Device-free consumption and persistence of already mixed native queue/pump PCM; whole-App native-to-offline restore and return
changes: Bounded OfflineOutput is prepared by the original OutputCheckpoint validator and preserves canonical sample bits and queue/pump order
Offline consumer copies or discards already mixed prefix before requesting new mixer frames; mixer frame counter is not incremented twice
Partial prefix is saved through the original output wire format, including capacity, complete pump block and exact suffix cursor
AudioPlay logical owner carries pending prefix; ordinary legacy offline archives without output retain their prior wire shape
Host policy/window selects actual native destination; a native archive can restore offline without opening hardware
Native source retiring to a logical target uses the original final permit/receipt: empty old device queue, swap all owners, close device last
Native transport and logical pending prefix are mutually exclusive in each active AudioPlay; no second mixer/runtime or lossy conversion

checks.clippy: editor and audio-device all targets -D warnings, exit 0

regressions: Core renderer preserves negative zero/subnormal/nonzero prefix bits; binary partial checkpoint resumes exact remaining sequence and suffix cursor
Editor budget case: 1050 already mixed queued frames; first 800 consumes prefix without mixing, second 800 consumes 250 and mixes exactly 550; partial save/prepare matches
New actual GPU/native case cancels logical destination without closing original native connection or changing scene/counters
Whole-App native archive loads offline, retains exact runtime/clock/PCM/output wire, consumes prefix over 120 game/render frames with frames=archived+96000-prefix_count
Same native file then loads on an already logical source without hardware and returns to native output
Physical native Session decodes to logical owner with entire playback record exactly equal, including outstanding PCM, without device connection
Legacy negative native-to-offline decoder assertion replaced by exact preserved-output positive assertion; corrupt output rejection retained; initial log preserved
limits: Consumed-prefix frame counter intentionally tracks newly mixed frames, not consumption of frames already included in archived mixer position
Offline AudioPlay uses its established discard sink; standalone OfflineOutput.render_prefix exposes the same exact samples for consumers
Only application-owned queue/pump data is preserved; native/analog buffers and audible continuity are not qualified
Reconnect/device replacement/rate changes, native window, latency/power/FPS and full ENG-03 through ENG-13 remain open
